extracted_from.header: build.py page(): .brand (logo tile 40px, radius 10px, bold name) + nav Home / Privacy / Terms
extracted_from.app_icon: assets/app-icon-1024.png (brand logo A of dataonthemap-studio: ring, equator, one meridian, a teal pin with a paper halo)

fonts.sans: Roboto (the last named face of the site's system-ui stack; the site itself loads no web font)
fonts.mono: Roboto Mono (paths and the build command only)

concept.banner: The page top bar carries the name as the site does (logo tile + brand + nav) and the home h1 is the headline. The logo globe is drawn large from its own geometry and used as the site map: one teal pin per page build.py writes, each with a .card callout holding its path.
concept.diagram: The flow runs along the globe equator; each stage is a logo pin with a .card callout, edge labels sit on the equator. Site header with a How it works nav item and the footer rule.

assets.docs/images/how-it-works.png: src/diagram.html, 1600x900 @2x (light scheme on an opaque paper frame: reads on GitHub dark and light)

motif.globe: ring + equator + one meridian in ink, stroke about 6% of the diameter; thin graticule lines in the line colour
motif.pin: accent dot with a halo in the page background colour
